# IGI Global Scientific Publishing

> International academic publisher specializing in peer-reviewed journals, books, and e-resources across business, education, science, technology, and medicine disciplines.

IGI Global operates a comprehensive scholarly publishing platform serving researchers, librarians, and institutions globally. The publisher maintains the InfoSci Platform for accessing peer-reviewed research and offers various subscription models including open access, Read & Publish, and evidence-based acquisition options.

## Key Topics

- Academic Publishing
- Peer-Reviewed Research
- Scientific Publishing
- Open Access Journals
- E-Book Collections
- Scholarly Journals
- Book Publishing
- Manuscript Submission
- InfoSci Platform
- Institutional Licensing
- Double-Anonymous Peer Review
- STM (Science, Technology & Medicine)
- Business & Management
- Education & Social Sciences
- Read & Publish Models

## Core Publishing Services

- [IGI Global Scientific Publishing Homepage](https://www.igi-global.com): Main portal showcasing academic publishing services and platform overview
- [About IGI Global Scientific Publishing](https://www.igi-global.com/about): Company information including history, mission, and global operations overview
- [Journals](https://www.igi-global.com/journals): Double-anonymous peer-reviewed journals across 200+ disciplines in tech and medicine
- [Books](https://www.igi-global.com/books): Book catalog featuring reference works in business, STM, and education subjects
- [Publish with IGI Global](https://www.igi-global.com/publish): Author guidelines and submission information for journals and book publishing

## Digital Resources & Collections

- [E-Book Collection](https://www.igi-global.com/e-resources/e-collections/e-book-collection): E-book collection with institutional licensing and unlimited simultaneous access
- [OnDemand Database](https://www.igi-global.com/e-resources/ondemand): OnDemand database providing peer-reviewed research papers and book chapters
- [Database Search (InfoSci Platform)](https://www.igi-global.com/infosci-demo): InfoSci Platform database search tool for discovering books and journal articles
- [Clinical Solutions](https://www.igi-global.com/e-resources/clinical): Clinical solutions offering healthcare research and medical publishing resources
- [Business Solutions](https://www.igi-global.com/e-resources/business-medical-solutions): Business solutions with e-book collections and institutional subscription licensing

## User Portals & Access

- [Publisher Portal](https://www.igi-global.com/portal): Publisher portal for submission management, peer review, and editorial system access
- [Researchers](https://www.igi-global.com/researchers): Researcher resources for accessing peer-reviewed research and submitting manuscripts
- [Librarians](https://www.igi-global.com/librarians): Library-focused resources for e-book licensing and consortia partnerships
- [Chinese Language Portal](https://www.igi-global.com/zh-cn): IGI Global's Chinese language portal serving the Chinese academic community

## Distribution & Partnerships

- [Distributors](https://www.igi-global.com/distributors): Distributor network directory and partnership resources for book and journal distribution
- [Book Title List](https://www.igi-global.com/distributors/books/title-list): Searchable book catalog and publication database for distributor partners

## News & Community

- [Newsroom](https://www.igi-global.com/newsroom): Press releases and news on STM publishing, open access, and research standards
- [Newsletter Signup](https://www.igi-global.com/newsletters): Newsletter subscription and email registration for updates and announcements
